meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.9
§ Miamin or Mijamin = "from the right hand"
1) chief of the 6th course of priests established by David
2) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
3) a priest who went up with Zerubbabel
4) a priest who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

elsewhere.note: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, and Izziah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
